page.notes: Marginal note "Vrbs Groningæ emporium quondam celebre," is printed in three short lines with hyphens; the reading "ingæ" is uncertain in the scan. The printed "eos .tum" has a stray space before "tum" and "xx iv" has a space inside the numeral; both are kept as printed. The last line "siam" is set at the right after "controver-" and is joined to it. The bottom edge of the scan carries a digitiser's watermark, not transcribed.
